episode.showDescription: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

transcript_window.text: It was edited by Elena Silverman.
Special thanks today to Rachel Lissy, our website, ThisAmericanLife .org,
where you can stream an archive of over 800 episodes for absolutely free, and there's videos and lists of favorite shows and tons of other stuff there too.
This American Life is delivered to public radio stations by PRX, the public radio exchange.
Ira Glass will be back next week with more stories of This American Life.
